entities.summary: The Denmark Democrats is a conservative and right-wing populist political party in Denmark. The party was founded in June 2022 by Inger Støjberg, and is officially titled Denmark Democrats – Inger Støjberg. The party is currently in opposition to the second Frederiksen government.
